details: Positive integers represented by green tokens (+1); negative integers represented by red tokens (-1).
Zero Pair: Combination of (+1) and (-1) tokens has net value 0.
Additive Inverse: The number '-a' that yields 0 when added to 'a'.
Subtraction Rule: Subtracting an integer is equivalent to adding its additive inverse: a - b = a + (-b).
evidence_or_examples: Physical token bag simulation for visually impaired learners

details: Positive multiplier (+m) × (+n): Add n positive tokens m times -> Positive result (+mn).
Positive multiplier (+m) × (-n): Add n negative tokens m times -> Negative result (-mn).
Negative multiplier (-m) × (+n): Remove n positive tokens m times from empty bag (insert zero pairs first) -> Negative result (-mn).
Negative multiplier (-m) × (-n): Remove n negative tokens m times from empty bag (insert zero pairs first) -> Positive result (+mn).
evidence_or_examples: (-4) × (-2) = +8 derived by inserting 8 zero pairs and removing 8 red tokens

details: Division is the inverse of multiplication: if a × b = c, then c ÷ b = a and c ÷ a = b.
Distributive Property: a × (b + c) = (a × b) + (a × c) holds for all integers.
evidence_or_examples: Freezing room temperature dropping from 32°C at 5°C/hr reaching -18°C in 10 hours
Submarine descending at 4 m/min vs mine elevator at 5 m/min
